title: Unified rollouts: probing/quarantine autorollback observability enhancements
author: Ava Chen
description: Context: Improve observability for probing and quarantine stages in unified rollouts to make autorollback decisions transparent to SREs and product teams. Motivation: previous incidents exposed gaps in telemetry around probe pass/fail signals, quarantine durations, and metric-quorum decisions; debugging rollbacks required deep tracing and ad-hoc logs. This PR adds structured telemetry and dashboards to shorten time-to-detect and time-to-debug. Changes: 1) Add rollout.probe.{start,success,fail} metrics with tags: rollout_id, stage, region, model_variant, test_set (low-cardinality); 2) Emit rollout.quarantine.{enter,exit} events with duration_ms and reason; 3) Enhance rollout.autorollback.decision events with metric_breakdown (top contributors) and quorum_state; 4) Attach trace_id to all rollout events and surface a trace_url in alert payloads; 5) Add dashboards: Rollout Probe Health, Quarantine Signals, Autorollback Forensics; 6) Add e2e tests that simulate probing failures and verify events, alerts, and trace linking; 7) Refactor autorollback engine to emit a single canonical decision event. Checklist: [x] telemetry schema defined and backwards compatible; [x] dashboards + alert rules added; [x] unit + e2e tests added; [x] changelog and release notes updated; [x] perf run in perf-lab completed. Notes: Metric names are additive and prefixed with 'rollout.'; alerts are disabled by default for small customers and are enabled per-tenant via config for enterprise customers. Rollout impact: negligible runtime overhead (tags only), sampling configurable for high-cardinality fields. How to test: ./scripts/e2e_rollout_test --scenario=probe-fail; perf-lab scenario 'quarantine_burst' for event volume validation. Related: ENG-4321 (observability spec), ENG-4590 (autorollback forensics), SUP-2104 (support escalation).
